title: Artist's Statement
text: Creativity is an element I value the most when crafting each of my works. Most of the works in my portfolio are composed of ideas and themes that arose from my imagination: dreams I wanted to bring to reality through putting them down on something tangible and recordable. My artistic process has been like this since I was five years old, when I was bold yet mindless enough to make indecipherable scribblings with a blue board-marker on the white, marble walls of my bathroom, which would remain my personal canvas until I was old enough to realize that what I was doing was not the norm for kids my age. Most of the time, however, I would just keep on doodling, recreating the ideas in my head on the piece of paper in front of me, not letting any thoughts of perfection and the anticipation of final results bother me. Eventually, one of the things I drew over the course of several sketch-papers would spark an idea worth pursuing. You can probably start to imagine how many pencils I would’ve turned to stumps in this everlasting process, repeated countless times throughout my life. This is also why, if you consider more closely, none of my works would’ve been possible without a strong foundation laid by my faithful Faber-Castell HB pencil.

title: How Far Generative Design AI has Come
text:
Believe it or not, the user interface shown above is 100% AI generated. The sole action I took was to prompt the visual model: "Design a mobile interface for a cryptocurrency trading application and make the theme color green."

Although this mockup produced by usegalileo.ai is far from being readily applicable to the high design standards set by the modern commercial realm, it's fascinating to see how far various kinds of AI (especially visual generative models) have come in just the past several years. What would take the average UI designer at least a couple dozen minutes to ideate, formulate, and design, AI is able to consolidate in a matter of seconds. If visual generative models such as Galileo continue to consistently improve, we may see conventional design processes become substantially facilitated and AI-based in the near future.
